kevin_sales: Quick: Prospect 'HealthGate' wants a 2-week POC. Must ensure EU-only data residency for customer records, prefer ireland primary, frankfurt allowed only for compute failover. BYOK required and keys must never leave eu-west-1 unless customer replicates. They also need a subprocessors CSV and a short line about routing guarantees + expected cost delta for a pinned tenant. cc @rachel_infra @amit_sec

 rachel_infra: We can do this on Dedicated or Private. Hosted can't guarantee strict key-region enforcement. For strict residency + BYOK-region-lock, Dedicated recommended. Note: if customer refuses key replication, we can block cross-region failover and return errors instead of routing.

 amit_sec: Subprocessors shortlist: AWS (eu-west-1, eu-central-1), GCP (europe-west3), Cloudflare, Fastly, Datadog, Sentry, HashiCorp Vault. One-line KMS answer: "Customer-managed HSM-backed BYOK supported on Dedicated/Private; Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys by default; Hosted-BYOK available under addendum with extra attestation."

 rachel_infra: Pricing note: locking a tenant to specific hardware/region requires reserved capacity. Ballpark uplift: reservation fee plus ~15-30% per-token increase depending on model mix and traffic profile. Need their peak rps and avg seq to get a proper quote.

 kevin_sales: They estimated peak 40 rps, avg seq 90 tokens. Can you sketch a quick sizing + a tiny routing policy example I can hand to their infra folks?

 rachel_infra: Sketch: 40 rps * 90 tokens = 3600 tokens/s. With batching and cache we expect 1.5x effective throughput. Aim for 2 reserved GPUs with a hot standby for failover to keep p95 under 70ms. Ballpark uplift: reservation ~$7k/mo + token uplift ~20-25%.

 rachel_infra: Tiny routing policy snippet for infra (plain text): tenant=healthgate-poc; residency=enforce_eu; primary=eu-west-1; failover_order=[eu-central-1]; on_key_unavailable=block_or_error; kms=byok_hsm_region_locked:eu-west-1; key_replication=customer_option

 amit_sec: Add to questionnaire: "If keys are region-locked, cross-region failover requires customer-managed replication or an explicit contractual exception that permits secure key wrapping in the failover region."

 presales_bot: Attestation pack and subprocessors CSV uploaded to /shared/presales/healthgate. Ops note: Dedicated provisioning 5-8 business days after PO & capacity confirmation; BYOK import + attestation 3-6 business days.

 kevin_sales: Great — I'll ask them to confirm whether they can replicate keys or accept blocked failover and then update the ticket. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
